reviews.review:
Unfortunately, the game simply isn't scary. I'm not a seasoned horror fan, and I'm actually quite frightened. But while playing this, I felt absolutely nothing. The game can't maintain its atmosphere and just constantly bombards you with "scary" sounds.

No matter how much the author praised the artificial intelligence of his creation, it's no different from hundreds and thousands of other monsters found in similar "crafts" on Steam. I kept silent and shouted, but he simply didn't care. The leveling system feels completely useless, and the puzzles are either too easy or too illogical.

I watched this project develop on YouTube, hoping that something truly interesting would emerge. I'd be lying if I said it didn't seem promising. But the monster isn't scary or clever, the atmosphere isn't frightening, and the missions—they're nothing to write home about.

To be completely honest, I liked this monster and the project itself much more in terms of code lines than in terms of gameplay. The locations were generally well-designed (textures, presence of obstacles, and TDs), albeit monotonous. I didn't feel any tension.

I can't recommend this game to anyone, and even though I understand it was essentially developed by one person, I can't say I liked it.

P.S. Cracking the eggs was fun. HEEELLLL YEAAAHHHHH
